page_title: ALA 2-2 GIR | Alaves v Girona 10/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Solis Romero J. E. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' 2 - 2 Jon Guridi (Alaves) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
90+9' Rafa Marin (Alaves) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
90+8' The referee can't ignore those comments and Yangel Herrera (Girona) sees a yellow card for bad language.
90+6' A cross from a corner kick by Alaves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+6' Alex Sola (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
90+4' Jesus Owono (Alaves) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
90+4' Luis Rioja (Alaves) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+2' Aleix Garcia (Girona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
89' None of the Alaves players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
89' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) serves up a nice cross, but Paulo Gazzaniga punches the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Alaves will have a corner.
88' Arnau Martinez (Girona) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
86' A cross from a corner kick by Alaves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

86' Alex Sola (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Alaves will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' Corner kicks – 2:2.
84' Michel prepares a substitution. Savio is replaced by Valery (Girona).
82' Great teamplay by Alaves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
82' Alex Sola (Alaves) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Paulo Gazzaniga and he's equal to it.
80' A substitution has been made. Javi Lopez goes off and Ruben Duarte (Alaves) comes on.

79' Eric Garcia (Girona) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
78' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Girona.

78' Yangel Herrera (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play and Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
78' The players claim that Ianis Hagi (Alaves) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. Girona earn a free kick.
75' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Yan Couto (Girona) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
73' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kike Garcia walks off the pitch to be replaced by Joaquin Panichelli (Alaves).
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Giuliano Simeone will be replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).
73' Michel has decided to substitute Ivan Martin and he is replaced by Aleix Garcia (Girona).
73' Substitution. Viktor Tsygankov makes way for Pablo Torre (Girona).

71' Alaves slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

69' Ivan Martin (Girona) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
68' That's unlucky! Artem Dovbyk (Girona) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
67' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Luis Rioja (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
66' 1:1 – the corner kicks stats.
63' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Ianis Hagi (Alaves) replaces Carlos Benavidez.
63' Here comes a substitution. Carlos Vicente is given a rest as he is replaced by Luis Rioja (Alaves).

62' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Alaves are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

61' Kike Garcia (Alaves) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
60' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
59' Here is a change. Portu is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Yan Couto (Girona).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanpe (Girona) is coming onto the pitch as Miguel Gutierrez cannot continue after picking up an injury.
57' It doesn’t look good for Miguel Gutierrez (Girona); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!

56' Savio (Girona) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
53' 27:73 – the ratio of ball possession.
51' Savio (Girona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
50' Excellent touch by Artem Dovbyk (Girona)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
50' Girona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
47' Ivan Martin (Girona) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jesus Owono sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post.
46' Alaves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+3' Javi Lopez (Alaves) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
45+2' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Alaves.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 1 - 2 Goal! Great play by Artem Dovbyk releases Yangel Herrera (Girona) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into the top right corner. 1:2.
40' Javi Lopez (Alaves) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' Javi Lopez (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Jon Guridi (Alaves) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Paulo Gazzaniga makes a great save.
37' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
36' Savio (Girona) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
34' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jesus Owono is quickest to intercept the ball.
32' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
29' A pass by Carlos Vicente (Alaves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
28' Alaves fail to score from a corner as Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) leaps to collect the ball.
28' Alaves are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
24' Girona enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
19' Javi Lopez (Alaves) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the left side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.

18' A decent save by Paulo Gazzaniga. Carlos Vicente (Alaves) finds some space near the penalty spot to meet a cross and head it down to the middle of the goal, but the effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
17' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
14' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' 1 - 1 Jon Guridi (Alaves) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.

9' Ambitious effort from Jon Guridi (Alaves). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
7' Wonderful movement by Girona. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

4' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Eric Garcia (Girona) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header inside the right post. 0:1.
4' Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
3' Yangel Herrera (Girona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Girona force their opponents to concede a corner.
3' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Girona will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Jose Luis Munuera Montero.
